name: Halvard Filing Cabinet Aero
description: The Halvard Filing Cabinet Aero. A dependable office pick with a clean, no-nonsense design and the everyday features you actually use.

specs.inTheBox: Filing Cabinet, Assembly tools, Wall anchor, Assembly guide, Floor protectors

reviews.author: Farah M.
reviews.title: Solid, boring, reliable
reviews.body: Bought this after returning two other brands. Nothing has rattled loose or started creaking yet. Halvard seem to have got this one right. Happy to recommend it.

reviews.author: Pooja P.
reviews.title: Solid, boring, reliable
reviews.body: Picked it up on a whim and it has earned its place. Build quality is genuinely good for the price. Second Halvard product I own and both have lasted. Happy to recommend it.

reviews.author: Kavya P.
reviews.title: Better than expected
reviews.body: Replaced a five-year-old unit with this. Build quality is genuinely good for the price. Halvard seem to have got this one right. Would buy the same one again.

reviews.author: Farah B.
reviews.title: Would buy again
reviews.body: Picked it up on a whim and it has earned its place. Nothing has rattled loose or started creaking yet. Halvard seem to have got this one right. No regrets.

reviews.author: Ishaan R.
reviews.title: Worth every rupee
reviews.body: Picked it up on a whim and it has earned its place. Nothing has rattled loose or started creaking yet. Packaging was tidy and nothing was missing. Would buy the same one again.

reviews.author: Ishaan H.
reviews.title: Disappointed
reviews.body: Wanted to like this one. Support were polite but slow to respond. First Halvard product that has let me down. Cannot recommend it as-is.
